entries.0a67dafc01db861e: It operates chains under the trade names of the fast food formats 'Omuraisu-tei', 'Nagasaki Chanmen' and others. The omelet rice specialty restaurant 'Omuraisu-tei' is being actively expanded as the 2nd pillar after the core yakiniku business. It is also advancing store openings for the tempura format 'Ageten-ya'.
entries.28755a01b1695f9d: A company that operates restaurants in multiple formats, such as yakiniku, sushi and izakaya, both directly and through franchises, and conducts the food service business under its parent company G-Communication.
entries.61b3aab717a0aeb1: Consolidated subsidiary Takemoto Foods Co., Ltd. handles the centralized operation of the food court 'RINKU FOOD PARK (Rinku Food Park)'; Kabe no Ana Co., Ltd. develops chains under the Italian format 'Kabe no Ana' and others; DBT Co., Ltd. operates the French format 'Dominique Bouchet Tokyo' and others; G-Aqua Partners Co., Ltd. operates the food and beverage business of the Shikoku Aquarium; and Furansutei Co., Ltd. develops chains under the steak and curry format 'Furansutei' and others. G-Academy Co., Ltd. is a dormant company.
entries.671b5cb4f1cd0324: It is the core business of the company group, operating chain stores under the trade names of the yakiniku formats 'Nikusho Sakai' and 'Yakiniku-ya Sakai'.
entries.81226077d8a6fdfe: Everyday Meals and Fast Food Business
entries.911256dbca1d33dd: It operates a chain under the trade name of the sushi format 'Heiroku Sushi'. Consolidated subsidiary Marushichi Co., Ltd. operates a chain under the trade names of its sushi and seafood izakaya format 'Shichifuku' and others, and holds Echo Shoji Co., Ltd. (which holds buying rights at Toyosu Market) as a subsidiary. Overseas, it operates in Asia on a franchise chain basis.
entries.a390ee6de2d128a4: It operates a chain under the trade names of the izakaya formats 'Toriaezu Gohei' and 'Murasaki'.
entries.e0209a312c1c81ce: It is the sole reportable segment of the company group. Under its parent company, G-Communication Co., Ltd. (ownership of voting rights 50.31%; receives financial support and management guidance), the group operates restaurants in formats such as yakiniku, sushi, izakaya, and everyday meals and fast food, through directly operated stores and franchised stores. It has eight consolidated subsidiaries and two affiliates, and as of March 31, 2026, the number of consolidated employees was 719. It is listed on the Standard Market of the Tokyo Stock Exchange.
